project_name: FlipCraft - Free Interactive PDF to Flipbook Studio
theme: Dark / Light Adaptive Studio Theme (Defaulting to sleek Studio Dark UI with crisp high contrast viewer canvas)

layout_strategies.dashboard: High Density Grid (MODE B) with stats cards, recent flipbook list, filter search bar, and instant PDF dropzone
layout_strategies.editor: 3-Pane Layout: Left toolbar & element picker, Center interactive canvas with drag-and-drop resize overlays & page navigation, Right sidebar for overlay properties & brand settings, Bottom thumbnail filmstrip
layout_strategies.viewer: Full-bleed immersive studio view with floating glassmorphism toolbar (zoom, sound toggle, fullscreen, share/embed, page navigation arrows, thumbnail drawer)
layout_strategies.embed_mode: Minimal chrome iframe view optimized for responsive embedding with subtle flip controls

key_features_to_implement: No-login local-first persistent storage (localStorage / IndexedDB / mock backend API fallback)
PDF Upload & Multi-page canvas rendering fallback with sample PDF preset templates (Product Catalog, Corporate Magazine, Portfolio, Cookbook)
Page-flip 3D engine with audio sound synthesis (Web Audio API realistic paper flip sound on page turn)
Interactive Overlay Canvas in Editor: Drag, resize, delete, and configure hotspots (Uploaded Video / YouTube / Vimeo iframe, Images, Clickable Web Links)
Brand Settings panel remembered across all flipbooks: Custom Logo image/URL, Brand Name, Accent Color picker, Brand Website Link
Share & Embed Modal: Shareable link generator, responsive HTML <iframe> embed code with copy-to-clipboard, width/height customize options
Public Flipbook Viewer: Fullscreen mode, Zoom pan & drag controls, Page counter, Table of contents / Thumbnail strip drawer, Audio toggle
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure clean JS structure (not TSX files). Implement smooth interactive page transitions with canvas/CSS 3D transforms. Synthesize realistic paper flip sound using HTML5 Audio or Web Audio API synthesis oscillator/noise generator. Include fully interactive editor drag-and-resize hot spots for embedded YouTube, Vimeo, MP4 video, picture overlays, and clickable external links. Support persistent saved Brand Settings.
